stem: What is the message the author expresses in the selection “Tradition with a Twist”?

options.label: A
options.text: Children should be taught to make old dishes.

options.label: B
options.text: Very few people can make old dishes correctly.

options.label: C
options.text: People respect old dishes even when they change them.

options.label: D
options.text: Old dishes should be made by the community.
